subject: Atlas Payments: CAIQ control ownership roster & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Alex Crawford <alex.crawford@atlaspayments.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlaspayments.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ follow-up + sample outputs needed

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our CAIQ extract with a few high-priority control areas we need evidence for (encryption in transit, key management, and privileged access reviews). Can your team provide an ownership roster mapping Redwood controls to the CSA/CAIQ IDs and share the most recent artifacts (config screenshots, policy snips, SOC page references)?

Targeting our vendor review meeting on 2026-11-10, so a short sprint plan would be helpful. Let me know if you prefer a synchronous walk-through vs. handing off a package.

Attachments: 20261101-CAIQ-questionnaire.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Crawford
Security Program Manager
Atlas Payments

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Crawford <alex.crawford@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up + sample outputs needed

Alex —

Appreciate the PDF and the clear priorities. Proposed approach from our side:
- Triage controls in the CAIQ extract into three buckets: "ownerable by product", "ownerable by infra/security", "requires cross-team evidence."
- Build a control ownership roster (CSV) that maps each CAIQ control ID to an internal owner, expected artifact type, and target deliverable date.
- Run a 72-hour evidence sprint to collect screenshots, config exports, policy excerpts, and relevant SOC page links.

I've looped in: Marissa (control mappings & contractual artifacts owner), Olga (evidence collection lead — infra screenshots, KMS artifacts), and Neha (customer-facing doc + redaction). We'll aim to deliver an initial roster + index by EOD 2026-11-02 and the first evidence bundle by 2026-11-03. If that meets Atlas timelines we can do a quick sync on 2026-11-04 to walk through the artifacts.

Quick question: for encryption key material, do you need key lifecycle logs or a control narrative is sufficient to start?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Alex Crawford <alex.crawford@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up + sample outputs needed

Adding my notes —
- I'll own the CAIQ-to-CSA-CCM mapping and the contractual evidence bundle (terms page, data processing addendum, SOC link).
- For each control I'll add a short narrative (2-3 lines) that points to the artifact location in the evidence index.
- Deliverable plan: controls-ownership-roster.csv + ca iq-evidence-index.xlsx (with Drive links and artifact types) by 2026-11-02 17:00 PT.

On Alex's question about key logs: we'll include a sanitized example of KMS audit events for lifecycle operations, plus the key rotation policy excerpt. Let us know if you need full logs (we would require an NDA amendment).

—Marissa
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Alex Crawford <alex.crawford@atlaspayments.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up + sample outputs needed

Folks —

Attached: an early draft of the ownership roster and a first-pass evidence index. I pulled screenshots from staging that show TLS configuration, our KMS key alias page, and the admin audit view (sanitized). The file names are included below.

Attachments: controls-ownership-roster.csv; ca iq-evidence-index.xlsx; sprint-plan-2026-11.docx

Notes:
- I mapped CAIQ controls for encryption in transit (CAIQ: ENCR-01) to our runtime TLS config docs and to the edge proxy screenshot.
- KMS/cmk questions mapped to CAIQ: KM-02 — included key policy snippet and rotation schedule (policy excerpt).
- Privileged access reviews mapped to CAIQ: IAM-07 — included an example quarterly review export (redacted), and the RBAC policy doc link.

If Atlas wants raw logs for key operations, we'll need a secure transfer method — I can stage an S3 export and share a presigned link that expires after 7 days.

—Olga
Sr. Infra Engineer (Security Ops)
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Crawford <alex.crawford@atlaspayments.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up + sample outputs needed

Alex —

We've completed the initial sprint deliverables and uploaded the evidence package to the shared Drive folder. Highlights:
- controls-ownership-roster.csv (owner, primary contact, expected artifact type, SLA for refresh)
- ca iq-evidence-index.xlsx (artifact list, redaction status, Drive link)
- sample artifacts: tls-proxy-20261101.png, kms-policy-excerpt.txt, privileged-access-review-q3-2026.pdf

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Atlas-CAIQ/ownership-roster

If you'd like a synchronous review, we can book a 30-min call tomorrow 2026-11-04 at 10:00 PT. Otherwise, we'll hold for Tracker comments and iterate.

Thanks — and happy to provide additional evidence if Atlas needs raw logs (we'll need an inbound transfer agreement).

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
